data.one_liner: A fully customizable bottom sheet widget easy to implement in a Scaffold.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SolidBottomSheet widget that can be placed on a Scaffold's bottomSheet property. It supports custom headers, swipe interactions, automatic swiping, visibility toggles, and a controller for programmatic control.
use_when: You need a custom bottom sheet with swipeable headers and body content.
You want programmatic control over bottom sheet visibility and height via a controller.
avoid_when: You require standard Material modal bottom sheets spawned via showModalBottomSheet.
You need complex native-feeling nested navigation inside the sheet.
strengths: Easy to integrate into the Scaffold's bottomSheet property.
Provides stream-based control and monitoring of height and visibility.
Highly customizable header and body widgets.
weaknesses: Lacks an automatic shadow covering the back of the bottom sheet out-of-the-box.
Some properties like canUserSwipe and showOnAppear are deprecated.
